Chhath Puja 2026 : lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ko lekar jharkhand ki rajdhani ranchi men utsah dekhne ko mil raha hai... chhath ki kharidari ke lie bajaron men logon ki bhari bhir umar rahi hai... phal, sup, daura aur puja se juri dusri jaruri samagriyon ki kharidari men log jute hue hain...bajaron men chhath mahaparv ki raunak saph najar aa rahi hai... dekhie ranchi ke bajaron se chhath ki taiyariyon ki khas tasviren
